info.title: glab-mcp-server
info.description:
GitLab CLI MCP Server - Provides access to the internal GitLab server functionality through glab commands.

General Usage:
- Use --help flag with any tool to get detailed usage information
- For large outputs, use limit/offset parameters for pagination
- Check 'total_size' in response metadata to navigate results
- Most tools support common flags like --output for formatting

post.description:
Read-only access to public GitLab repositories in the internal GitLab server.

This tool accesses only public repositories. No authentication is required. Do not request or provide GitLab tokens.

Use this tool to read repository files, list repository trees, and search source code. Only GET operations are allowed.
